findings.summary: Cuccinelli holds dual roles: National Chairman of Election Transparency Initiative (with Cleta Mitchell) and Senior Fellow at Russ Vought's Center for Renewing America. ETI collaborated with ALEC to pass Only Citizens Vote model bill. Authored DHS chapter of Project 2025. Former acting DHS deputy secretary and USCIS director. FEC shows donations to DeSantis-aligned Restore Our Nation PAC from Spotsylvania VA.
Gov. Glenn Youngkin appointed Ken Cuccinelli to the University of Virginia Board of Visitors in March 2025. Cuccinelli is a UVA Class of 1991 alumnus. This is an interim appointment.

Cuccinelli authored the DHS chapter of Heritage Foundation Project 2025, advocating stronger executive control over federal agencies, tighter border enforcement, and significant restructuring of immigration services.
Kenneth T. Cuccinelli II is listed as Director of Care for Others Inc in both Virginia and Florida corporate registries. Entity type and mission not yet determined from registry data alone.
Cuccinelli is partner at Cuccinelli and Day PLLC, a law firm in Fairfax, Virginia. No corporate registry filing found (PLLC may be registered under a different name or in Virginia only).

No FARA foreign agent registration found for Ken Cuccinelli. No lobbying disclosure filings. No FEC donations by Ken Cuccinelli personally (only relatives found: Albert, Sheila, Dennis, Richard with small-dollar donations to WINRED, ACTBLUE, DCCC, NAIFA).

Cuccinelli operates at least 6 organizational roles simultaneously: (1) National Chairman, Election Transparency Initiative; (2) Senior Fellow, Center for Renewing America; (3) Co-convener, Only Citizens Vote Coalition; (4) Treasurer, Cold Harbour Inc (FL corp with ex-Blackwater operators); (5) Incorporator, Free Them All Inc / Mission Safe Harbour (anti-trafficking nonprofit); (6) Director, Care for Others Inc (family nonprofit, EIN 884380598); (7) Board Member, Federal Fiscal Sustainability Foundation (EIN 881466149); (8) Board Member, NAIFA; (9) Board Member, Meadowlands Area YMCA. Additionally served as co-author of Project 2025 DHS chapter.

CPI is the fiscal hub connecting Cuccinelli's organizations. CPI granted $1.35M to CRA (2022), $584K to CRA (2021), $525K to Election Integrity Network (2022), $1.33M to America First Legal Foundation (2021), $1.15M to Personnel Policy Org (2022), $1M to American Voting Rights Foundation (2021), $795K to FAIR Elections Fund (2023). CRA (where Cuccinelli is Senior Fellow) also granted $228K to Election Integrity Network (2022) and $100K to American Accountability Foundation (2022). Total trackable CPI disbursements to election/immigration apparatus exceed $6M (2021-2023).

ETI is structurally NOT an independent entity — it is a joint project of SBA Pro-Life America and American Principles Project launched Feb 2021 with $5M budget. ETI does not appear to have its own EIN. The two ETI entries in our entity DB (entity #974 US, #995 DC) represent the same organization recorded from different sources, not a 'filing cluster' of new entities. The auto-lead trigger detected the same org being registered twice in our system. However, the structural arrangement means ETI funding flows are invisible — they run through APP and SBA 990s, making independent financial tracking impossible without their Schedule F data.

Cuccinelli's FEC donation history shows two patterns: (1) Regular $1,041.02 contributions to Restore Our Nation (RON PAC, DeSantis-aligned) from Spotsylvania VA as 'self-employed consultant' throughout 2023, totaling approximately $5,200; (2) Father Kenneth T Cuccinelli (Fort Myers FL, retired) also donating to same RON PAC and Draft DeSantis 2024 Fund. Cuccinelli backed DeSantis over Trump in 2023 primary — significant given his subsequent role in Trump-aligned CRA/ETI infrastructure. No Cuccinelli FEC donations to Trump committees found.

Cold Harbour Inc (FL) is a commercial entity co-owned by Cuccinelli with Dave Lopez (ex-Navy SEAL, former Blackwater operative) and Foster Coulson. Cuccinelli serves as Treasurer. Cold Harbour was formed not three months before Cuccinelli incorporated Free Them All Inc (DBA Mission Safe Harbour) — an anti-sex-trafficking nonprofit in VA. Lopez is co-director of Mission Safe Harbour. Lopez also co-owns supplement companies catering to anti-vaxxers, one of which had a promotional deal with Mission Safe Harbour sending proceeds from kids' vitamin sales to the nonprofit. This represents a commercially entangled nonprofit structure connecting a former acting DHS deputy secretary with private military contractors.

Gov. Youngkin appointed Cuccinelli to UVA Board of Visitors March 27, 2025 (replacing fired member Bert Ellis). VA Senate Privileges and Elections Committee blocked the appointment 8-4 in June 2025, citing Project 2025 authorship, anti-LGBTQ positions, and reproductive rights stance. Senate Democrats subsequently filed lawsuit in Fairfax County Circuit Court to bar Cuccinelli and other appointees from continued service. Cuccinelli also testified before House subcommittee on immigration and election matters in 2025 and appeared on C-SPAN in Dec 2025 discussing Trump immigration policies.

Restoration of America is a major dark money conduit feeding the election enforcement apparatus. 2022-2023 grants include: $5.08M to SBA List (ETI fiscal sponsor), $2.88M to APP (ETI fiscal sponsor), $2.1M to Fight Voter Fraud Inc, $1.43M to Lawyers Democracy Fund, $3.6M to Over the Horizon, $2.6M to Tea Party Patriots Action, $2.5M to American Majority Action, $1.17M to Liberty Initiative Fund. Restoration of America itself received $8.4M from National Christian Charitable Foundation (2023). This establishes a funding chain: NCCF -> Restoration of America -> APP/SBA -> ETI (Cuccinelli). Additionally, CPI -> CRA (Cuccinelli) and CPI -> Election Integrity Network (Mitchell). Both tracks converge at OCVC.

Cuccinelli testified before Kansas House Committee on Elections Feb 27, 2025 supporting SB6 (ranked-choice voting ban) on behalf of ETI. Separately testified July 15, 2025 before House Homeland Security Subcommittees on Oversight and Border Security at hearing 'Case by Case: Returning Parole to Its Proper Purpose' as CRA Senior Fellow. Also testified before Senate HSGAC Jan 16, 2025 on immigration. This demonstrates Cuccinelli's dual-track advocacy: election law restrictionism (ETI hat) and immigration enforcement (CRA hat), testifying before at least 3 legislative bodies in first 7 months of 2025. His bio was prepared by 'Michael Bars' per PDF metadata (April 2025).
